selectorSummary: Live Product Selector is prepared in read-only mode. Products module remains source of truth. Listing can reference selected product facts but must not duplicate or mutate them. The selector may list or reference products only if an existing safe read-only Products service is available. No writes, migrations, eBay API calls, drafts or publication are allowed. Missing or unconfirmed product facts remain blocked.

architecturePolicy.productsRule: Products decide what the product is.
architecturePolicy.listingRule: Listing decides how the product sells on eBay.
architecturePolicy.benchmarkRule: Benchmark decides what is working in the market.
architecturePolicy.gatesRule: Gates decide whether the listing can advance.
architecturePolicy.operatingPrinciple: Benchmark can suggest. Listing can adapt. Products must confirm. Gates must approve.
architecturePolicy.sourceOfTruthRule: The Products module is the source of truth for product facts.
architecturePolicy.readOnlyRule: The Listing module may read product facts but must not mutate product records.
architecturePolicy.selectorRole: The selector chooses a product reference for listing generation without copying facts as independent truth.

readOnlySourceAudit.reasonLiveReadDisabledOrDeferred: Keep this loop contract-first because lib/products-service.ts includes read functions but also contains separate write functions and error logging; wire a minimal read-only wrapper in the next loop.

productListContract.selectionBehavior: Admin may view/select a product reference in a future loop; this loop prepares the read-only contract.
productListContract.mutationBehavior: No product mutation is allowed from the listing selector.

requiredHumanActions: Confirm which product fields are safe to display in Listing.
Confirm product facts mapping from Products to Listing Generator.
Confirm live read function to use.
Keep product mutation blocked from Listing.

nextRecommendedLoop.loop: LOOP 123 — Real Product Facts Mapping to Listing Generator V1
nextRecommendedLoop.reason: After the read-only product selector exists, map real selected product fields into the listing generator as referenced facts with missing-field blockers.
nextRecommendedLoop.expectedOutcome: The listing generator receives selected product facts by reference and updates the draft preview readiness based on confirmed versus missing fields.
constraints: Do not duplicate product facts as listing truth.
